issues.description: Radar chart with 6 dimensions (Warmth, Complexity, Organic, Layered, Heritage, Character) is completely missing from the visible screen. Expected to be present in the 'YOUR STYLE DNA / Fingerprint Map' section.
issues.root_cause: The radar chart component is either not rendered, conditionally hidden, or the 'Fingerprint Map' section is below the fold but may not be rendering the chart at all. Could be a missing import, a null data guard that returns null, or a charting library (e.g. recharts RadarChart) not receiving the required data props.

issues.description: Tweak input field is missing. The expected behavior specifies a text input allowing users to tweak their style fingerprint before continuing.
issues.root_cause: The tweak input field component is either not implemented or not rendered in apps/web/app/design/step-4/page.tsx.

issues.description: The CTA button says 'Design My Room' but expected behavior specifies a 'Continue' button. The button label is wrong for this step.
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-4/page.tsx the button text is hardcoded as 'Design My Room' instead of 'Continue'.
